stem: A young child needs an essential radiograph and a parent must hold the child during the exposure. Which protective approach matches the guidance?

options.text: A lead apron for the parent, and a thyroid collar for the child when the thyroid is in the primary beam
No protective garment for the parent, since only the child is imaged
A thyroid collar for the child only when the thyroid is outside the primary beam
Routine shielding of the child for every exposure, because it is considered necessary
